summary: VivoSim Labs filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary Organovo, Inc. entered on October 13, 2026 into a Second Amendment to its Amended and Restated Lease with landlord San Diego Inspire 2, LLC for its San Diego headquarters. The amendment shrinks the premises by requiring surrender of Suite 202 by February 28, 2027, extends the Suite 100 term through April 30, 2028, sets monthly base rent at $43,072.85, and grants $86,145.70 of aggregate abatement for March–June 2027. This is a routine lease amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
